description: Store reusable active units as database-backed components with type, lifecycle, trust boundary, version, body, labels, and relationships.
review_gate: promotion_decision must be promote_candidate or reviewed stable definition

description: Store facts, checks, labels, dimensions, review routes, tool-call patterns, index records, and embedding work items as first-class subcomponents linked to a component or source object.
review_gate: high-risk subcomponents require review_status before public exposure

description: Keep component versions in the database with body hashes and source references so repository files can be import/export views instead of the production source of truth.
review_gate: active versions require deterministic validation and compatibility checks

description: Emit search-ready keyword, vector, graph, facet, quality, freshness, and cost rows from canonical component and subcomponent tables.
review_gate: vector readiness and committed-count audits must pass before readiness claims

description: Generate static docs, JSONL packs, or repository files as public exports from the database-backed component registry.
review_gate: do not export private tenant rows, sensitive data, or unreviewed high-risk items
